Cloud

Isolement du Système Invité

The practice of isolating virtual machines (guests) from each other and from the host system to prevent unauthorized access and limit the impact of potential breaches in multi-tenant cloud environments.

Quick answer: The practice of isolating virtual machines (guests) from each other and from the host system to prevent unauthorized access and limit the impact of potential breaches in multi-tenant cloud environments.

Questions and answers

What is Isolement du Système Invité?

In this glossary, Isolement du Système Invité refers to: The practice of isolating virtual machines (guests) from each other and from the host system to prevent unauthorized access and limit the impact of potential breaches in multi-tenant cloud environments.

How is Isolement du Système Invité used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Configurez les hyperviseurs pour appliquer un isolement strict des systèmes invités afin d'empêcher les mouvements latéraux et les fuites de données entre les machines virtuelles."

Definition

The practice of isolating virtual machines (guests) from each other and from the host system to prevent unauthorized access and limit the impact of potential breaches in multi-tenant cloud environments.

Operational example

Configure hypervisors to enforce strict guest operating isolation to prevent lateral movement and data leakage between virtual machines.

Localized term

Isolement du Système Invité

Localized example

Configurez les hyperviseurs pour appliquer un isolement strict des systèmes invités afin d'empêcher les mouvements latéraux et les fuites de données entre les machines virtuelles.
